svg.title: Workshop card: use letterforms as windows onto the material photograph
svg.desc: Only the CLAY lettering fill changes from solid ink to a fixed photographic pattern. Its outlines, position, size, weight, the separate banner photo/crop and all supporting copy remain unchanged. Original fictional design. Photographs previously generated with AI and reused unchanged; expressive typography composed separately with a fixed variable-font weight.
svg.text: BEFORE · Solid title beside the photograph
AFTER · The photograph fills the letters
